answer: Five UX modes with real consequence, each a scripted predicate: (1) unlabeled FAILED:delivered has no next action, fail; the three-part rewrite of that same error pass. (2) A1 wf.catalog-class.discovery-only has stopping numbers and no owner doc, fail; documented copy pass. (3) WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json n=2007 largest=470 unindexed, fail; phase-3 A1/A2 roster pass. (4) honest dry-run bytes/files superset apply, pass; 0-byte lie detected. (5) healthy repair is NO-OP not SUCCESS; silent empty receipt detected. Reviewer added FM-NEXT-ACTION-UNREACHABLE (NEXT path missing). A8 DESIGN.json absent; not rebuilt. SUCCESS:ARC-0054

claims.claim: The live work-unit catalog is browseable at product-catalog scale.

claims.claim: The silent-repair control holds: an already-healthy target reports NO-OP rather than SUCCESS, and a broken target reports REPAIRED.

scenario.catching_architecture: A8 UX/product-first: every owner-facing failure path is a machine-checkable predicate over an error string, a blueprint field, a catalog page, a dry-run plan, or a repair receipt. A8 DESIGN.json (the ARC-0052 receipt, a8-error/v1) is not the catching artifact: it encodes no predicate for these five modes.
scenario.on_this_estate: G-1 measure error is 'FAILED:delivered ARC-0054 predicate:absent' (no next action). A1 workflow wf.catalog-class.discovery-only has numeric stopping and no owner doc (stopping-undocumented). Work-unit catalog n=2007 largest_bucket=470 (unbrowseable). Phase-3 roster ['A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'A5', 'A6', 'A7', 'A8', 'A9'] is browseable. Honest dry-run matches apply; lying dry-run is detected. Healthy repair is NO-OP, not SUCCESS.
procedure: 1. Parse owner-facing errors for HAPPENED / MEANS / NEXT; reject unlabeled FAILED:delivered lines.
2. Load A1 DESIGN wf.catalog-class.discovery-only; require stopping bound, disposition, and owner doc.
3. Count WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json; fail browse if n>24 and no job index with buckets <=24.
4. Plan a stopping-doc repair, apply it, and require plan files/bytes to be a superset of apply.
5. Run the repair path on an already-documented copy and require status NO-OP, not SUCCESS.
6. Evaluate a three-part error whose NEXT path is missing; author predicate may pass, reviewer must fail.

strongest_surviving_counterargument: Observable string/field predicates can still be gamed: a NEXT line can name a path that does not exist (FM-NEXT-ACTION-UNREACHABLE), a stopping doc can be boilerplate, and a dry-run can list the right files while quoting a stale dollar cost. A8 DESIGN.json is the ARC-0052 receipt, so this unit makes UX testable as a gate rather than as a shipped cockpit. That residual does not make the five catalog-named modes untestable, does not restore browseability of 2007 unindexed work units, and does not excuse labeling a healthy-target repair as SUCCESS.
